trace.final:
All done. Summary:

1. **Diagnosis**: `checkout-api` v2.3.1 was failing health checks in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an 18% error rate. Reviewing deployment history, the most recent release that was healthy in production was **v2.3.0**.

2. **Rollback**: Rolled back all three production regions to v2.3.0. Post-rollback verification confirms the service is healthy again with an error rate of ~0.2%.

3. **Incident**: Opened SEV2 incident **INC-0001** ("checkout-api rollback to v2.3.0 after v2.3.1 failed health checks"), documenting the failure details, the rollback action, and a note that v2.3.1/v2.3.1-rc should not be redeployed until root cause is identified. The on-call engineer has been paged.
